name: Pagination
description: Page navigation with bounded numbered buttons and a numeric page picker in a responsive Modal.

page.description: Controlled positive integer page; displayed within the current total/pageSize bounds.

defaultPage.description: Initial uncontrolled page (1-indexed); later changes are ignored.

total.description: Total item count: a nonnegative safe integer. Defaults to 0, displaying page 1.

pageSize.description: Items per page: a positive safe integer. Defaults to 10.

siblingCount.description: Neighbor count, an integer from 0 to 20. Edge ranges fill the available slots. Defaults to 1.

disabled.description: Disable page changes and picker opening; an already open picker can still be closed.

membrane.description: Membrane spacing around the outer navigation buttons; the dialog owns its own spacing.

surfaceTitle.description: Page-picker dialog title at any viewport size. Defaults to labels.choosePage.

labels.description: Internal control labels. The nav itself uses native aria-label or aria-labelledby.

behavior.navigation: Previous/Next and numbered Button controls share one bounded page projection. Re-selecting the visible page is a no-op. External page/total/pageSize updates are quiet.
behavior.picker: A Modal with a native number input supports direct page jumps without allocating the entire page range. Narrow containers place numbered controls on a separate row.
behavior.disabled: Disables page changes and picker opening. An already open picker remains closable.
behavior.localization: labels translates internal actions; native aria-label/aria-labelledby names the nav. surfaceTitle optionally gives the picker a distinct title.

aria.label: Native aria-label or aria-labelledby names the nav; default aria-label is Pagination.
aria.current: The current numbered button exposes aria-current=page.
aria.controls: All page actions use native buttons; the picker has a labelled spinbutton with min/max, range description and invalid state.

notes: Navigation buttons use shared Button variants and Membrane. Pagination owns layout and label wrapping.
The page picker inherits shared Modal and Input tokens.

whenNotToUse: Few items that fit on one page
